list.title: Tools
list.subtitle: MCP servers your agents and workflows may call.
list.emptyText: Pick one from the catalog, or add an MCP server by its URL with the headers it needs (such as a token). Its actions are listed for you.
list.noRunner: Runner · not on a runner yet

catalog.title: Tool catalog
catalog.description: Ready-made MCP servers. Pick one to set it up.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.settingHint: {{help}} Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.
catalog.oauth: It signs in with OAuth. Once it is installed, enter your OAuth client's id and secret on its page, then Connect. The sign-in asks for {{scopes}} only.
catalog.runnerSteps: {{name}} runs on your own machine. Add this under <0>mcpServers</0> in the runner's <1>config.json</1> there, then restart the runner.
catalog.runnerStepsKey: {{name}} runs on your own machine. Add this under <0>mcpServers</0> in the runner's <1>config.json</1> there, with your key in place of “<2/>”: it stays on that machine, then restart the runner.
catalog.pickNote: Once the runner is restarted, pick it: agents on its harnesses can then use {{name}}.

settings.title: Sign-in
settings.needed: Needs sign-in: enter its {{settings}} to use it. Until then nothing calls it.
settings.connected: Connected. Enter new settings to replace them.

pollable.title: What polls may read
pollable.text: A trigger that polls this tool calls only these, outside any Job and without asking. By default, what the server marks read-only.
pollable.asked: Not polled: {{agents}} must ask before using it.

authorize.text: Not connected yet: sign in to the server to list its actions.

reauthorize.text: The sign-in stopped working: its calls fail until you sign in again.

signIn.title: Sign-in
signIn.clientIdHint: Only for a server that gave you one: most need none.

sheet.actionFailed: Could not change the action. Refresh and try again.
sheet.saveFailed: Could not save the tool. Check the details and try again.
sheet.description: An MCP server reached over HTTP. It acts as whatever account its headers, or its sign-in, authorize.
sheet.resetFailed: Could not reset the field. Try again.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.urlSecret: Set: the URL holds a secret, so its template is shown. Type a new URL to replace it.
sheet.urlHint: Headers are only sent to an https:// URL.
sheet.oauthHint: You sign in to the server; Dispand keeps the sign-in encrypted and renews it.
sheet.elsewhere: This is another address: the saved headers are not sent there. Enter again the ones this server needs.
sheet.encrypted: Values are stored encrypted and never shown again.
sheet.saveAddress: Save the new address before connecting: the sign-in is for the server the tool is saved with.
sheet.actionsNote: Disabling stops an action for agents, polls and workflows. Re-enabling keeps each agent's permissions; CLI sessions need a new session.

runnerSheet.description: An MCP server your runner starts on its machine, as its config.json says. Its command and keys stay there. Only agents on a harness of that runner can use it.
runnerSheet.noServer: This runner reports no MCP server: add one under mcpServers in its config.json, then restart it.
runnerSheet.notReported: This runner doesn't report {{server}}: add the snippet to its config.json, then restart it.
runnerSheet.serverHint: The names under mcpServers in the runner's config.json.
runnerSheet.pluginDescription: A stdio server of the plugin {{plugin}}. Your runner runs it only once that machine allows its files and launch entry: run the command below there, then restart the runner.
runnerSheet.removedDescription: A stdio server of a plugin that was removed: nothing runs it anymore, unless you point it at one of the runner's own MCP servers.
runnerSheet.allow: To allow it, run on the runner's machine
runnerSheet.notAFile: Its command isn't one of the plugin's files: allowing it covers the command line, not what that command runs or downloads.
runnerSheet.noServerDescription: A stdio server its plugin no longer offers, or keeps no files for: update the plugin, or point this tool at one of the runner's own MCP servers.
